title: The Slow Signal
author: Mirabel Voss
blurb: Casper Ashgrove, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
